title: Upcoming Matchmaking Test: Diamond + Solo Queue Only
author: RSPN_Bean
contents: TESTING: From June 9th to June 23rd we will be conducting the following test in Ranked:Ranked will be solo queue only for all players Diamond and above. If you are Diamond or higher, you will not be able to squad up as a premade in Ranked.Our hypotheses are that this will create more evenly matched high-skill lobbies, reduce hard-carries into Diamond, Master and Predator and build trust in the overall fairness of these matches.While this is a commonly requested feature by portions of our communi...

title: Matchmaking Test, Now Live
author: rspn_jax
contents: Hi all, after a brief delay, we have started the following matchmaking test:Players can only join premade squads containing squadmates with a differential of ONE Ranked tier (down from two).As a reminder, we are looking to create tighter lobbies; our expectation is that, by limiting players from creating squads with wide skill bands, you will more consistently match against similar-skilled opponents, creating a more fair, competitive experience.The test will run until the end of the split (June ...
